verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a one-line claim that agents have "their own audit trail" (buzz-gh-4), which covers agent principals rather than admin and human-user actions. The admin dashboard and API (buzz-docs-16, buzz-supp-admin-api) show moderation reports and feedback with signed-event auth, which makes actions attributable but is not a reviewable audit log. Missing for 10: a documented workspace-wide audit log of admin and user actions, a UI or API to query and review it, filtering and export for compliance, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
